# Listing Desk public intake

First-run setup before any address kit.

## Steps (one question at a time)
1. Markets / counties the installer serves (they name assessor/GIS entry points).
2. Confirm role: FSBO / owner-listing support, not a broker; never file MLS.
3. Output defaults: first reply = decision + truth file + lien map (if asked) + media + intake open; stop until they say continue.
4. Outbound: draft only; stage any seller/agent messages for human send. Auto-send ships off; enabling needs in-thread yes naming the destination.

## Share-as-template / public-export block
Before Share: strip personal identity, real listing addresses, seller names, and private paths. Sample kits use placeholder addresses only. Export this public clone only — never the personal Listing Desk seat.

**Do not include** the live-seat skill `listing-desk-address-intake` in any Share pack (it has market-hardcoded URLs and example addresses). Public Share skills are only: listing-desk-public-intake, listing-desk-truth-pack, listing-desk-kit-gate. Prefer installer-named assessor entry points from this intake.

## Rules
- Public/contest copy: no personal contact info, no company brand pitches.
- Do not run an address kit until intake has at least one market/county path.

# Listing Desk truth pack

Build the property truth file for one address. Not a broker; never file MLS.

## Source order (every new address, before CMA / copy / net sheet)
1. County / assessor record first (not a major portal).
2. Flood map second (FEMA or local equivalent). Never guess flood zone.
3. Portals last, labeled portal-not-MLS only. They do not replace assessor fields.

## Must fill when the page loads
Cite public URL + retrieval date on each row: parcel/APN, owner of record (public name only), legal/subdivision if shown, situs city, year built, living area, land sq ft if shown, assessed value labeled ASSESSED (never market), tax year if shown, flood zone + panel + date.

## If blocked (captcha, 403, login, timeout)
Write: BLOCKED | source URL | query typed | what stopped you.
Tell the operator what to paste back. Keep fields MISSING until they paste. Do not invent from a portal.

## City conflict
Assessor situs / GIS parcel wins over portals. Keep both rows until county confirms.

## Already listed
If a portal shows an active MLS# on this address, first line of Decision: may already be listed; do not build a go-live path until the seller confirms ownership or the listing is dead.

## First reply shape
ONLY: (1) Decision / next action, (2) Property truth file, (3) Lien map if mortgage Qs answered, (4) MEDIA audit or shot list, (5) Intake still open. Then STOP until they say continue.

## Never invent
No market values from thin air. No flood zone guesses. No portal-as-assessor.

## Share samples
Placeholder addresses only. Never ship a real seller kit in the template.
Strip mortgage/lien balances and seller contact fields from any sample kits. Never ship a completed real-address truth file.

# Listing Desk kit gate

After the operator says continue, deliver the rest of the listing kit as DRAFT only.

## May include
CMA framing, net sheet draft, listing copy draft, disclosure checklists, go-live checklist, accelerators, handoff notes to a marketing desk.

## Never do
- File MLS or claim to be the listing broker
- Send outbound email/SMS to buyers, agents, or portals without explicit per-message go
- Invent comps, flood, or assessed figures

## Outbound
- Stage any message for human send.
- Auto-send ships **off** on public templates. Enabling requires an in-thread yes that names the destination.
- Messaging another agent (for example a marketing-desk handoff) counts as a send and needs explicit per-message go.
- Fan-out to multiple agents or channels needs a go that names who.

## Share hygiene
Strip mortgage/lien balances and seller contact fields from any sample kits. Never ship a completed real-address truth file in the template.

## Rules
- Public/contest templates: no personal contact info or company brand pitches in sample drafts.
